title: Per-sender seq in outer envelope may link senders
description: spec/05 §5.1.1 places a per-sender sequence number in the outer routing envelope; relays could link one sender's messages across envelopes (S1). Move inside ciphertext or derive per-epoch. Found in JMAP batch review 2026-10-16.
close_reason: Decided: move seq inside ciphertext (see sibling task)
